scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist node_modules/.vite && find . -name '*.map' -delete 2>/dev/null; echo cleaned
scripts.zip: npm run clean && cd .. && zip -r ymusic-lite.zip ymusic-lite -x 'ymusic-lite/node_modules/*' -x 'ymusic-lite/dist/*' -x 'ymusic-lite/android/*' -x 'ymusic-lite/ios/*' -x '*.map' -x '*DS_Store*'
